name: Tony Perry
background: Tony Perry is a Pine Bluffs, Laramie County resident (mailing city on the candidate filing) who ran as the Constitution Party nominee for House District 10 against incumbent Justin Fornstrom and lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election, as already recorded from official results.

The Wyoming Tribune Eagle published a House District 10 candidate page for him on Sept. 30, 2026, and recorded that no questionnaire was received. A new search of public sources for this fill did not find an occupation, education, or military record.
